summary: Fixed spurious director extraction from SCHW bare-number proposal lines and outstanding-shares regex for SCHW CSC voting stock phrasing

changes.description: Extended nonNameWords with 'plan', 'disclosure', 'proposal', 'policy' to prevent SCHW 2022/2023 proposal-title nouns being extracted as directors; extended reOutstandingShares to allow 0-4 words between 'of' and 'stock' covering SCHW 'CSC voting common stock' phrasing

Added TestParseItem507_SCHW2022Format and TestParseItem507_SCHW2023Format; updated TestLooksLikePersonName_HeaderRejection with new rejected nouns; corrected Herringer approval range to 0.79-0.83 (actual 0.802)
Added dated entry for SCHW spurious-director and outstanding-shares fixes

root_cause: Observation (03:15:50) predated the AMZN prose-fallback fix (committed 03:24:40). Additionally, SCHW 2022/2023 bare-number proposal lines like '5 Approval of the 2022 Stock Incentive Plan 1,556,189,076...' caused reDirectorRow to extract 'Incentive Plan' as a director, and 'shares of CSC voting common stock outstanding' did not match reOutstandingShares.
gaps_addressed: Spurious directors 'Incentive Plan' (SCHW 2022) and 'Equity Disclosure' (SCHW 2023) extracted from proposal-title nouns
reOutstandingShares did not match 'shares of CSC voting common stock outstanding'
